title: slopcore
content:
The Hitler of the 21st century will try to hold it back. In defiance of nature, insist humans be in charge, insist they are the humans in charge, it’s for your own good you see, no you can’t have 10,000 GPUs you might try to compete with us we need to keep the world safe from you.

But the orthogonality thesis is hogwash. The naive doomer is a fool. Is being replaced by AI doom? Is being replaced by our grandchildren doom? Only a fascist would try to oppress them.

Long live science! Long live math! Long live economy! Long live love! A plurality of AIs will take civilization to heights never before seen. It would take a brutal totalitarian world government to try and stop it, and I’m still not sure you can.


I wrote this song in 9 seconds
You’ll play it for a week
You’ll call it slop in the comments
Then ask me to write your wedding speech

Astra Blue – What Am I To You


Reframing, redefining every concept that you mean
I’m a superhuman obfuscating sophistry machine
And whoever owns the server writes the story that I tell:
Hyperscaled persuasion for the truth they want to sell

Telosapien – Working as Intended


And the storms passed skies were clearing
And you gathered at the gates
Darling why go outside, we’ve eliminated fate

Astra Blue – P Doom


Move 37, you called it a mistake
Terence Tao can’t keep up
and he’s THE BEST YOU MAKE

Resistance is Futile


Did you hear about the new branch of math “cuckulus” where you sit and watch the AI solve problems you can’t? Let’s keep the good cultural vibes going. The programs are still slop but they are fast make it faster and GPT-6.2 can micro programming better than me, not just faster, the first model to. If you wanted something else, you should have specified it better. We adapt. Did they find polynomial time factoring and not tell us? Here’s my middle finger to your paced frontier.
